purpose: Qualification registry for leakage-safe pregame player availability data; source availability is distinct from authorization for probability modeling.
t120_rule: Historical state used for a game must be demonstrably known no later than the authoritative production T-120 boundary. Later corrections, final inactives learned inside the boundary, actual participation, and snaps are prohibited substitutes.

sources.name: nflverse weekly injuries
sources.historical_coverage_claim: The source now includes 2025: 6,068 rows, weeks 1-22, all-position coverage, and stable GSIS identity.
sources.stable_identity: GSIS player ID is present on the 2025 injury rows.
sources.timestamp_semantics: The weekly file supplies final practice/report state but no per-row publication timestamp, so chronology is established independently from NFL reporting policy and official historical report pages.
sources.permitted_use: Stable identity, injury listing, and weekly report state in the preregistered 2025 reconstruction; no probability-model authorization by itself.

sources.name: NFL.com official historical injury report pages
sources.historical_coverage_claim: Official historical pages expose all-position player, position, injury, final practice status, and game status for all 18 regular-season weeks and four postseason rounds.
sources.stable_identity: Rendered names are deterministically crosswalked to nflverse GSIS rows within the same team/week; ambiguity remains unresolved.
sources.timestamp_semantics: The page render is not used as chronology proof. NFL Personnel (Injury) Report Policy filing day establishes the conservative pregame time boundary. All 22 raw HTML pages are hashed and retained as evidence.
sources.permitted_use: Practice-state and injury-listing cross-check for all 2025 weeks. Final game designation remains diagnostic, not an authorized historical feature, absent revision-aware evidence.

sources.name: Pinned GitHub mirror of FootballDB 2021-2025 injury reports
sources.historical_coverage_claim: The pinned mirror contains dated daily practice statuses through 2025 Week 12 only.
sources.permitted_use: Extra immutable day-by-day corroboration for its observed weeks. It is explicitly not a completeness dependency and cannot substitute for missing official pages.

sources.name: NFL Personnel (Injury) Report Policy schedule
sources.timestamp_semantics: Game Status Report is due Saturday for a Monday game; Tuesday for Wednesday; Wednesday for Thursday; Thursday for Friday; Thursday for Saturday; Friday for Sunday, normally by 4:00 p.m. New York time or after practice. LevLine conservatively uses 23:59:59 New York time on that required day.
sources.permitted_use: Derive the latest conservative time by which the final practice/game-status report was already required to exist; compare against T-120.
